quick_answers.question: Is ICE ORCA DRAGON one undifferentiated knowledge graph?
quick_answers.answer: No. Hypercomplex algebra, legacy prediction/narrative history, CPT temporal-folded SUSY, and an independent IG-RUEQFT locality audit remain separate graphs. This collection supplies only qualified navigation between them.

quick_answers.question: What survives in the hypercomplex programme?
quick_answers.answer: Several finite algebraic structures survive in their declared convention, including the assessor orbit chain, XOR regularity, finite identities, and an explicit S3 subgroup. The currently indexed hypercomplex subset does not establish Standard Model referents.

quick_answers.question: Did the finite IG-RUEQFT locality oracle validate bulk locality?
quick_answers.answer: No for the frozen N=64 free-U(1) charge-dephasing discriminator: the entropy ratios decrease rather than approaching the registered bulk-volume predicate. The same result does not refute all interacting or continuum IG-RUEQFT realizations.

quick_answers.question: Did the legacy numerical predictions pass their recorded gates?
quick_answers.answer: No genuine P01-P15 or gravity signal survives the stored gates, and Git does not independently timestamp the declared prediction lists before their comparisons.

quick_answers.question: Is the CPT Gate 1 route closed or ready for Phase 57?
quick_answers.answer: No. Phase 56 and the three historical bounded Gate-1 windows are consumed; their retry, full replay, Phase 57 and global promotion remain forbidden. Distinct clean committed unnumbered calculations use one generic capped runtime. The trace-gauge branch reaches a classical U_plus Darboux chart, a compact-interior principal endpoint FIO, and one improved-static BFV zero-mode source. A selected densitization H=12pi^2 exp(3Q/2) C with flat ordering has a Fourier--Kontorovich--Lebedev RAQ p>0 model: kappa0=sqrt(3/2)p/hbar and physical measure dp/(2sqrt(6) hbar p), which is not the static dp fiber measure. Its p=0 cutoff control rules out a naive nonzero-edge extension by positive logarithmic divergence, admits a linearly vanishing witness, and leaves finite-part reference scale noncanonical; raw C, rescaling equivalence and a canonical p=0 completion remain open. The local BFV Ward control makes direct Berezin and induced-determinant elimination agree; unweighted deletion is KILL. Lapse modulus, contour and absolute BFV measure remain unselected, so unique full trajectory completion is still contradicted. Exact endpoint construction, arbitrary-state/full-real-lapse rigging map, global cycle, physics and TOE outputs remain open or null. Gate 1 stays open and automatic_next is null.

quick_answers.question: Is the user-primary ICE narrative preserved as evidence?
quick_answers.answer: It is preserved as primary narrative and motivation, not promoted into computational evidence. Exact source-backed wording is separated from later interpretation.

quick_answers.question: Has any of this been promoted into an external KG or a physics verdict?
quick_answers.answer: No automatic promotion is claimed. Some exact or related legacy UID lookups resolve, but lookup resolution is neither external acceptance nor physics ratification; unresolved bridges remain repository-local across the collection. The repository ontology is only a memory and index layer.
